description: ⚠️ Destructive: Remove one or more IAM policies from a group. Policy IDs are sent in the request body as policyIdList (the API takes no policy ID in the path). Set confirm=true to execute.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute

policyId.description: Single policy ID to detach. Merged into policyIdList when sent; kept for backward compatibility

policyIdList.description: List of policy IDs to detach. Provide this or policyId

name: ncloud_detach_policy_from_group
